// diagnostic

E0771

A function value's public call labels or parameter zones do not satisfy the expected function type (D-APILABEL1)

What

A function value's public call labels or parameter zones do not satisfy the expected function type (D-APILABEL1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Match the function value's call labels and parameter zones to the expected function type.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0771: tests/ui/fn_type_zone_call.stderr.

Error [E0769]: `force` is a label-only parameter of `action`
  --> tests/ui/fn_type_zone_call.jet:3:65
    |
  3 | fn apply(action: fn(*, force: Bool) Int) Int -> { return action(true) }
    |                                                                 ^^^^
 Why: The `*` in the declaration requires the label, so the call says what the value means
 Fix: Write `force: …` for this argument
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0769

Error [E0771]: This needs fn(*, force: Bool) Int, but the function value is fn(Bool) Int
  --> tests/ui/fn_type_zone_call.jet:5:23
    |
  5 | fn run() { _ :: apply(save) }
    |                       ^^^^
 Why: Public labels and parameter zones are part of a function's callable type
 Fix: Use `fn(*, force: Bool) Int` here
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0771
